summary: SLM Student Loan Trust 2005-7 filed an 8-K (Item 8.01 Other Events) reporting a failed remarketing of its class A-5 notes. On April 22, 2026, sufficient committed purchasers were not obtained at the proposed spread, so all existing noteholders must retain their notes. The interest rate will reset to SOFR + 0.75% per annum with a three-month period until the next reset on July 27, 2026. This is a routine contractual mechanism in an asset-backed security trust and does not represent a special situation event such as a strategic review, acquisition, or restructuring.
